caption: The drawing depicts two human figures within an oval frame set against a natural, outdoor background. On the left side, an adult figure with brown hair is seated or kneeling on grassy terrain, wearing a long, flowing blue garment with draped folds accented in darker blue, and holding a yellowish book or tablet in the left hand. The right hand is extended towards the other figure. To the right, a smaller figure, possibly a child, with brown hair is lying on the ground on a reddish-brown blanket, partially dressed in a light-colored garment with faint blue stripes, and appears to be sleeping with an arm tucked under its head. The background features large green-leaved trees with brown trunks, dense foliage, and undergrowth in varied shades of green, along with some blue and brown tones suggesting shading and depth. The composition is enclosed within an oval border, set against a plain beige background.
